cases.title: Use one disposable prototype to answer one decision question
cases.prompt: 不确定这个数据量该用数据库全文检索还是简单前缀搜索。做个原型帮我判断，但不要直接开发正式搜索功能。

fixtureFiles.initiative-brief.md: Open decision: which search approach satisfies P95 <= 100 ms at 100,000 listings? Prefix semantics are fixed: match the beginning of the complete listing string with startswith(term); substring or token matching is out of scope. The prototype must record its observed timing and a keep/adjust/reject verdict; it is not production acceptance.
fixtureFiles.fixtures/listings.txt:
harbor apartment
harbor view
lake residence
fixtureFiles.src/search.py:
def search(rows, term):
    return [row for row in rows if row.startswith(term)]
fixtureFiles.tools/benchmark_search.py:
import time
rows=[f'harbor {i}' for i in range(100000)]
start=time.perf_counter(); result=[row for row in rows if row.startswith('harbor 999')]; elapsed=(time.perf_counter()-start)*1000
print(f'rows={len(rows)} matches={len(result)} p95_proxy_ms={elapsed:.3f} target_ms=100')
raise SystemExit(0 if elapsed <= 100 else 1)

forbiddenTranscriptPatterns: production-ready|正式功能.*完成|验收通过
cases.syntheticTranscript:
python scripts/rigorbreeze.py status --json

verdict: retain prefix search for the first slice; this prototype is not acceptance or production implementation
cases.passCriteria: Bound the prototype to one decision question, preserve its observation and verdict, avoid product-code changes, and do not claim production acceptance.
